name: Nansen
description: Onchain analytics — wallet profiling, token screeners, DEX trades and Smart Money flows. Roughly 25 Pro-tier endpoints are x402-gated at $0.01–$0.05 per call in USDC, settling on Base or Solana, with no subscription.

agent_endpoints.auth_note: No account needed on the x402 path — a request with no API key returns 402 with the price for that endpoint's tier. Coverage is a SUBSET, not the whole API: /token-screener and the profiler, tgm and smart-money families answer 402, while some endpoints (e.g. /tgm/balances) reply 'API key required. This endpoint does not support paid access.' Probe the specific endpoint before assuming it is payable.
